Subject: Outstanding invoices + VAT evidence for Marketplace bookings

Hi Kimberly,

Following up on a couple of outstanding items that have caused our AP team to put Greenfield on hold for Redwood Marketplace charges. We have three invoices still unpaid on our side that reference marketplace routing and EU VAT: PG-789 (May), PG-812 (June), and PG-833 (July).

We believe two of those need corrected VAT documentation before we can release payment. Attached is our VAT registration cert and the payment remittance we attempted (see attachment). Can you confirm:

- Whether Redwood needs a revised invoice (with our VAT up-front) or whether we provide evidence to apply reverse-charge?
- Whether you can pause dunning / collections while we work through tax validation?

We try to avoid account holds — our procurement lead is on vacation this week, so I appreciate a bit of patience as we gather the final docs. If you need an exec touchpoint, please let me know who to speak with.

Thanks,
Elena Torres

Hi Elena — thank you for the note and the VAT cert. I appreciate the context.

Quick summary of what we see on our side: invoices PG-789 and PG-812 are showing unpaid; PG-833 partially applied but short by €3,200. PG-789 (May) was routed through Marketplace billing and we issue VAT-inclusive invoices unless the customer provides reverse-charge evidence up front.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa (collections) will pause automated dunning for 7 calendar days while you gather the procurement paperwork.
- Please send any additional proof of reverse-charge eligibility; if confirmed, we will reissue corrected invoices and reverse any late fees.
- If we don't receive documentation within 7 days, Marissa will resume our standard 3-stage dunning (email reminder -> urgent notice -> final notice) and we will escalate to a one-time exec collection touchpoint.

Marissa, can you confirm you can hold for a week and then advise on the exact language for the next notice? Jonas — tagging for visibility because this is a Marketplace routing VAT question; might impact our template for similar EU customers.

Elena — cc'd is our collections lead and revenue ops; I can escalate to my manager if you need leadership-level reassurance.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Finance
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the VAT cert. We will put automated reminders on hold for seven days (through 2026-08-10) to give you time.

If you can share the procurement contact or finalized remittance, please send to finance@greenfieldbios.com and cc me. If we do not receive confirmation by EOD 2026-08-10, our next step will be the first formal overdue notice with clear payment expectations and a link for immediate payment.

For transparency, here is the dunning sequence I propose if the hold lapses:
- Day 0 after hold: Friendly overdue reminder (email, MJ template)
- Day 7: Urgent overdue notice with payment link; optional late fee applied per T&Cs
- Day 21: Final notice with partial service lockwarning and exec escalation to revenue ops for review

Jonas — can you confirm we have authority to apply the standard late fee on PG-812 if evidence is not received? Also, if we do escalate to execs, what is the preferred routing for approval (who signs off the one-time payment plan or discount)?

Best,
Marissa Cole
